claim: The web demo is populated in one click, uses only demo-prefixed storage, resets, and the CLI demo writes only to a reported temporary directory.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context and fresh temporary working directory; inspect storage keys, reset/exit behavior, CLI output path, and current-directory contents

claim: The browser model works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh Chromium context at /demo; install service worker, switch the context offline, reload, and assert a populated result

claim: The ordinary browser model contacts no Collector and stores no inputs.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; intercept the complete model flow and inspect localStorage, sessionStorage, and IndexedDB

claim: CLI endpoints are loopback-only by default, while --allow-remote prints a warning.
sandbox: shipped sample in a temporary process; reject example.com, explicitly allow the TEST-NET address, assert warning, and hash the sample

claim: The CLI maps JSON or NDJSON to bounded requests with documented header, duration, rate, request, concurrency, size, and record limits.
sandbox: temporary two-line NDJSON and loopback capture server; assert exact bodies and header, then reject each documented out-of-range value

claim: The CLI reads the documented Collector queue and batch keys and reports templated values as unknown.
sandbox: shipped config plus a temporary templated config; assert every documented field and the warning

claim: The CLI reports stable, backpressure, or drops and emits scriptable JSON, including complete non-2xx loss.
sandbox: temporary fast, slow, and all-503 loopback receivers; assert classifications, counts, JSON, and exit behavior

claim: The CLI never edits the supplied Collector config or telemetry sample.
sandbox: hash both shipped inputs before and after inspect and demo paths

claim: The project builds one documented Rust binary and produces a publishable Cargo source package.
where: landing CLI section, README install and test sections
sandbox: clean build output; run --help, inspect the single binary declaration, and execute cargo package verification

claim: The website has no analytics, tracking, remote font, or third-party runtime request.
sandbox: fresh demo flow with all browser requests recorded, plus source scan for common tracking and remote-runtime hosts

claim: Home, demo, privacy, terms, metadata, MIT license, and the styled 404 are published.
sandbox: fresh browser and HTTP client; assert route statuses, titles, canonical/social metadata, heading focus, 404 copy, and LICENSE text

claim: The controlled 50 rps slow-exporter fixture reports its pressure threshold within 20 percent.
sandbox: run the isolated 20 ms serial loopback receiver regression and require its numeric 40–60 rps assertion to pass
